revision_controls: same-draft same-evidence review with normalized report
normalization: Remove engine identity and raw Turtle from LLM view; preserve claim/check/status/reason/source/field/locator. Keep engine-specific artifacts offline.
byte_identical_report_rule: If RP and RS normalized reports are byte-identical, one paid revision trace may be reused only as a declared shared derived outcome, not independent measurements.
projection_boundary: Model-declared atomic mapping must be audited for omitted natural-language claims and wrong bindings. Passing declared mappings does not certify their interpretation.
question_contract_boundary: No automatic natural-language question interpretation has been validated. Typed anchors or domain policies must be explicitly supplied and disclosed, never extracted from evaluator targets.
budgets: No new budget authorized. Old six-call sample estimates do not estimate this multi-stage workflow. Freeze attempts/tokens/reasoning/provider/prices/cache-write reserves before any future calls.
